question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.

prediction.sql:
WITH ol AS (
  SELECT product_id, qty,
         SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum
  FROM orderlines WHERE order_id=423
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, l.aisle, l.position, i.qty,
         SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id) AS cum
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN locations l ON l.id=i.location_id
  JOIN purchases p ON p.id=i.purchase_id
  WHERE l.warehouse=1 AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM ol)
),
j AS (
  SELECT o.product_id, i.aisle, i.position,
         MIN(o.cum) - COALESCE(LAG(i.cum) OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id ORDER BY i.cum),0) AS pick_qty
  FROM ol o
  JOIN inv i ON i.product_id=o.product_id AND i.cum >= o.cum
  GROUP BY o.product_id, i.aisle, i.position
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, pick_qty
FROM j
WHERE pick_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, aisle, position

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH need AS (
  SELECT product_id, qty FROM orderlines WHERE order_id=423
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, i.location_id, i.qty,
         p.purchased,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id
                            ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id) AS rn
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id=l.id
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id
  WHERE l.warehouse=1 AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM need)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT inv.*,
         SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn
                            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum
  FROM inv
)
SELECT r.product_id,
       l.aisle,
       l.position,
       MIN(LEAST(r.qty, n.qty - COALESCE(r.cum - r.qty, 0))) AS pick_qty
FROM ranked r
JOIN locations l ON r.location_id=l.id
JOIN need n ON n.product_id=r.product_id
WHERE r.cum <= n.qty
GROUP BY r.product_id, l.aisle, l.position
ORDER BY r.product_id, r.rn
